description: Canonical token values for the prism design system. Values are taken from the JSX source (canonical); see notes for derivations.

contrast_pairs.note: Teal badge numerals and indicators render as text on glass.
Builder text (24x, 10-14px; library/breadcrumb-default, library/button-ghost, library/form-field-default +15 more: '+', '1 of 12', 'Administrator') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (1x, 11-11px; library/label-required: '*') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (7x, 9-10px; library/badge-count, library/list-item-default, library/list-item-selected +3 more: '1', '2') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (7x, 9-14px; library/card-elevated, patterns/dashboard, patterns/modal-default: 'CONFIRM', 'Cancel', 'Elevated card') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (5x, 10-11px; library/card-elevated, patterns/dashboard, patterns/dashboard-default: '2m', 'Build itinerary?', 'featured or interactive ') renders as large_text (#7 text coverage).

Builder text (16x, 10-11px; library/form-field-with-help, library/list-item-compact, library/list-item-default +3 more: "We'll use this for login", '+12% from last month', '1d') renders as large_text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (2x, 10-11px; library/list-item-selected: '2m', 'Build day-by-day itinera') renders as large_text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (1x, 10-10px; library/form-field-with-error: 'Please enter a valid ema') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (2x, 12-12px; library/table-row-selected: 'Administrator', 'alex@northwind.com') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (4x, 13-13px; patterns/dashboard, patterns/dashboard-default: 'Definitely a mix — templ', 'Hey, can you help me pla', 'Hey, can you plan my Tok') renders as text (#7 text coverage).
Builder text (1x, 14-14px; patterns/dashboard: '↑') renders as text (#7 text coverage).

extras.radius.avatar.note: JSX: 34px chat avatars are borderRadius 10; the radius table lists 'Avatar 10'.

extras.radius.badge.note: JSX: the 18px unread badge is borderRadius 6; the radius table lists 'Badge 6'.

extras.radius.message.note: JSX: message bubbles are borderRadius 16 on three corners (the tail is extras.radius.message_tail); the radius table lists 'Message 16'.

extras.radius.control.note: JSX: the sidebar search field (borderRadius 10) and the 30px send button (borderRadius 10). Compact controls about 30-32px tall: buttons, segmented groups, the search field and short form fields; the 44px composer keeps radius.input (14).

extras.radius.avatar_small.note: JSX: the 28px account avatar in the sidebar footer is borderRadius 8 (the 34px chat avatars use extras.radius.avatar, 10).

extras.radius.message_tail.note: JSX: message bubbles are borderRadius '16px 16px 4px 16px' (user) and '16px 16px 16px 4px' (AI): the tail corner is 4, the rest extras.radius.message.

extras.radius.checkbox.note: No checkbox in the JSX. A 20px box takes the badge radius (6, the JSX's 18px unread badge) so small squares share one rounding.

extras.radius.icon.note: No icon tiles in the JSX. The 20px icon placeholder takes the badge radius (6) like the other small squares.

extras.color.scrim.note: Black dim behind modals in the SVG layouts (the drawer uses it at 0.15 alpha); not in the JSX.

color.page_bg.note: The JSX paints the page with extras.page_gradient. #5A5562 is the spec's solid stand-in (gradient midpoint) for consumers that cannot paint gradients; a contrast gate should also test each extras.color.gradient_stop_*. The contrast gate tests every pair over page_bg and over each gradient stop (contrast_backdrops); the worst result counts (#7).

color.text_primary.note: JSX swatch 'Primary 0.95' (user-message text). Some chat titles use 0.85-0.9. Contrast fix (#7): rgba(255,255,255,0.95) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.98). White glass text is already at L=1, so opacity is raised (smallest step that passes over every gradient stop). [color.text_primary on color.surface_elevated 4.38:1 -> 4.54:1 (min 4.5:1); color.text_primary on color.surface_selected 4.38:1 -> 4.54:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.text_secondary.note: JSX swatch 'Secondary 0.80' (AI message text). Contrast fix (#7): rgba(255,255,255,0.8) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.87). White glass text at L=1: opacity raised to the smallest value that passes over every gradient stop. [color.text_secondary on color.surface 4.1:1 -> 4.51:1 (min 4.5:1)] Contrast fix (#7 text coverage): rgba(255,255,255,0.87) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.98). White glass text at L=1: opacity raised to the smallest value that passes (text 4.5:1) on the elevated/selected glass tiers over every gradient stop. [color.text_secondary on color.surface_elevated 3.97:1 -> 4.54:1 (min 4.5:1); color.text_secondary on color.surface_selected 3.97:1 -> 4.54:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.text_placeholder.note: Live CSS: .gi::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25) } (the component contract table says 0.3).

color.surface_inverse.note: Glass never inverts; the strongest glass tier (user messages, 0.18) plays the inverse role. Contrast fix (#7): rgba(255,255,255,0.18) -> rgba(222,222,222,0.18). User bubble glass: text_inverse cannot get lighter, so the bubble tint moves (minimum OKLCH lightness change that passes, hue and chroma kept; alpha 0.18 kept). [color.text_inverse on color.surface_inverse 4.01:1 -> 4.51:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.accent_foreground.note: Teal is never a solid fill in the JSX (badges use the 0.25 tint with teal text). Dark slate gives 9.2:1 if it is.

color.action.note: Live send button uses base glass (0.08) with 0.7 white arrow; the component contract text says 'elevated glass'.

color.danger.note: No status hues in the JSX. Luminous pastels matching the teal accent's register, with a dark foreground. Contrast fix (#7 text coverage): #F59A9A -> #FFCBC9. Error copy is danger text on the page gradient (4.5:1 over the lightest stop); minimum OKLCH lightness change that passes, hue kept, chroma reduced only to the sRGB gamut limit at the new lightness. danger_foreground (#1F2B28) on danger gains contrast. [color.danger on color.page_bg 3.08:1 -> 4.52:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.success.note: Reuses the teal accent (the JSX's 'online' indicator).

color.border_strong.note: No strong border in the JSX; one glass tier above border_default.

color.focus_ring.note: No focus spec in the JSX; solid teal accent.

radius.input.note: JSX radius table: Input 14 (live composer is 14).

font.mono.note: Single-typeface system; mono falls back to Outfit.

space.md.note: Not named in JSX; 14px is the recurring panel gutter.

motion.fast.note: JSX .snd send button: 'transition: transform 0.1s', hover scale(1.05). exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.moderate.note: JSX .ci list rows: 'fadeSlideUp 0.3s ease', 70ms stagger; the row's glass tier shift on selection is 'transition: all 0.25s' (doc row: 250ms ease-out), rounded into this tier. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.slow.note: JSX .mi messages: 'fadeSlideUp 0.35s ease', 100ms stagger. The doc row says '500ms ease-out, 100ms stagger'; the implementation value is used. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.expressive.note: Not used by the JSX. Takes the doc row's 500ms ease-out entrance; the spring (bounce .2) is derived from the floating-glass grammar.

motion.reduced_motion.note: The JSX has no prefers-reduced-motion query: every animation (including the staggered entrances) plays regardless of the user setting. Reduced motion keeps opacity cross-fades (glass tier shifts, entrances) and drops travel and the hover scale.

color.text_inverse.note: Contrast fix (#7): rgba(255,255,255,0.95) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.98). Kept equal to text_primary (JSX uses one 0.95 white for both); not enough on its own, see surface_inverse. [color.text_inverse on color.surface_inverse 4.01:1 -> 4.51:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.text_muted.note: Contrast fix (#7): rgba(255,255,255,0.4) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.59). White glass text at L=1: opacity raised to the smallest value that passes (large_text 3:1) over every gradient stop. [color.text_muted on color.surface 2.2:1 -> 3.01:1 (min 3.0:1)] Contrast fix (#7 text coverage): rgba(255,255,255,0.59) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.66). White glass text at L=1: opacity raised to the smallest value that passes (large_text 3:1) on the elevated/selected glass tiers over every gradient stop. [color.text_muted on color.surface_elevated 2.72:1 -> 3.01:1 (min 3.0:1); color.text_muted on color.surface_selected 2.72:1 -> 3.01:1 (min 3.0:1)]

color.action_foreground.note: Contrast fix (#7): rgba(255,255,255,0.7) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.87). Send arrow on base glass: opacity raised to the smallest value that passes over every gradient stop. [color.action_foreground on color.action 3.55:1 -> 4.51:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.border_input.note: Contrast fix (#7): rgba(255,255,255,0.12) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.59). Inputs are glass on glass (fill ~1.1:1), so the stroke is what identifies them (WCAG 1.4.11, 3:1); white at L=1, opacity raised to the smallest passing value. border_default keeps the 0.12 hairline. [color.border_input on color.surface 1.29:1 -> 3.01:1 (min 3.0:1)]

color.accent.note: Contrast fix (#7): #7DDFBE -> #9CFFDD. Teal badge numerals are text on glass (4.5:1 over the lightest gradient stop); minimum OKLCH lightness change that passes, hue and chroma kept. Signature teal hue 170 and chroma 0.105 unchanged; focus_ring/success keep #7DDFBE (they pass). [color.accent on color.surface 3.35:1 -> 4.52:1 (min 4.5:1)]

extras.color.accent_tint.note: Contrast fix (#7 text coverage): rgba(125,223,190,0.25) -> rgba(70,170,140,0.25). Unread badge fill under teal numerals (accent text, 4.5:1): accent is already at the top of its lightness range (no lighter teal passes), so the tint behind it moves instead, darker at the same 0.25 opacity, hue and chroma kept. [color.accent on extras.color.accent_tint 3.72:1 -> 4.51:1 (min 4.5:1)]
